approach: Hybrid mirror+diode loads on failing diff pairs + reduced timer cap
approach_rationale: F5 already proves mirror+diode topology works (612mV span, 0.993 rho, 0.01% clip). Previous 'hybrid unviable' was mirror-ONLY without parallel diode. Parallel diode prevents bistability.

alternatives_considered.name: Increased timer discharge current
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Only helps F1/F2, not F3/F7. Would need 3x wider drain NFET, changing all power budgets.

alternatives_considered.name: Two-stage amplification
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Adds 6+ MOSFETs per feature, complexity not justified when single-stage hybrid works for F5.

alternatives_considered.name: Relax span threshold
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: User explicitly wants high range. F1/F2 Python d<0.3 for all class pairs, but F7 and F3 need the gain for Cohen's d.

steps.action: Reduce rr_timing timer cap from 320pF to 200pF for 1.76x more SF sensitivity
Replace diode loads with hybrid mirror+diode on rr_timing F1/F2 diff pairs
